title: plastic ladles
text: plastic ladles. Got these to go with a big plastic punch bowl for a shower... these are the perfect size and were a reasonable price.  They will fit any standard to large size punch bowl.  They are plastic so I am not sure I would use with anything other than cold drinks.  And be careful to wash with a soft cloth to avoid scratching.
